command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-visible-v4.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-eye-scheduler-attribution-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
DIR="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity"
HEAD=$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH_HEAD=$HEAD
python3 -m py_compile "$DIR/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_attribution_visible_v4.py"
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_scheduler_visible_v4_20260912_0940"
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
echo PRODUCTION_CHROME_BEFORE=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
set +e
python3 "$DIR/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_attribution_visible_v4.py" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9330 --cdp-port-base 9331 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_scheduler_visible_v4_20260912_0940.stdout.json"
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
echo PRODUCTION_CHROME_AFTER=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
if test -f "$OUT/report.json"; then cat "$OUT/report.json"; fi
echo VALIDATOR_RC=$RC
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_VISIBLE_X11_GPU_SCRATCH_CHROME_EXACT_SHADOW_NO_LIVE_WRITE
exit $RC
